audit_title: FINAL SCIENTIFIC CLOSURE, CLAIM QUALIFICATION & REPRODUCIBILITY AUDIT

preliminary_external_evidence.limitations: Small sample sizes; July 2023 single-episode storm surge; road-cut corridor accessibility bias; domain shift on extreme out-of-distribution events.

proxy_validated_prototype.limitations: Evaluated against 2D Sentinel-1 SAR microwave backscatter water masks; NOT in-situ river gauge field ground truth.

global_empirical_benchmark.limitations: Calibrated on 111 global historical dam breaches and 3 Himalayan events; local Upper Beas in-situ landslide dam breach data pending.

synthetic_benchmarked_prototype.limitations: Evaluated exclusively against statistically synthesized fixtures; synthetic benchmarks demonstrate algorithm functionality but do NOT establish empirical real-world validation.

pending_external_data.limitations: Awaiting official agency telemetry (IMD DWR radar, NCMRWF WRF 3km, BBMB Pandoh Dam logbooks, GNSS tiltmeters, Census socioeconomic vulnerability).

telemetry_reliability_qualification.qualification: Demonstrates software ingestion queue stability and database transaction throughput under simulated load. Does NOT guarantee physical LoRa RF packet delivery in mountain terrain.

leakage_audit_qualification.scope_limitation: Verified against 10,000 synthetic baseline training records; pre-2023 historical agency training datasets were not independently re-acquired.

claim_guard_qualification.limitation: Automated consistency scanner; does not replace peer-reviewed scientific evaluation.
